nodes.label: HCL Parser
nodes.desc: Wraps hclparse.Parser from hashicorp/hcl/v2 and caches every file's source bytes so diagnostics can render code snippets.

nodes.label: LoadConfigDir
nodes.desc: Reads every .tf and .tf.json file in a directory into a single Module, rejecting duplicate blocks along the way.

nodes.label: Config tree
nodes.desc: Module calls are resolved recursively into a Config tree whose Children map links each call name to a child config.

nodes.label: Context.Plan
nodes.desc: Entry point that takes the config, prior state and options, and returns a plan plus diagnostics.

nodes.label: PlanGraphBuilder
nodes.desc: Chains 32 transformers over config and prior state to assemble the plan graph, differing from the apply builder by deciding from desired state.

nodes.label: Graph DAG
nodes.desc: Graph embeds dag.AcyclicGraph; the built steps are validated for cycles before anything is walked.

nodes.label: Graph.Walk
nodes.desc: Visits vertices with full parallelism, running each node's DynamicExpand and Execute callbacks concurrently.

nodes.label: nodeExpandPlannableResource
nodes.desc: Expands one resource block into a per-instance subgraph honoring count and for_each during DynamicExpand.

nodes.label: GRPCProvider
nodes.desc: Core-side client of the go-plugin gRPC contract: ReadResource, PlanResourceChange and ApplyResourceChange requests.

nodes.label: states.State
nodes.desc: Top-level state: a Modules map keyed by module address, plus root output values and check results.

nodes.label: Change set
nodes.desc: During the walk each instance contributes a proposed change; these accumulate into the change set of the returned plan.

nodes.label: plans.Plan
nodes.desc: Context.Plan returns the plan artifact holding changes, drift, variable values and backend info for the CLI to show or apply.
